description: This file declares the XCast class, which implements a plugin for JSONRPC communication within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, handling application requests, and internal management of the Cast service. It also inherits from AbstractPlugin and RtNotifier, and defines several private static variables and private methods related to the XCast functionality.

classes.name: XCast
classes.description: A plugin class that handles JSONRPC communication for XCast functionality within WPEFramework, inheriting from AbstractPlugin and RtNotifier, with methods for managing Cast applications and service state.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Handles retrieving the API version number via JSONRPC.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles application state change notifications.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the Cast service based on parameters.

methods.name: getEnabled
methods.description: Retrieves whether the Cast service is enabled.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the plugin.

methods.name: onRtServiceDisconnected
methods.description: Callback when the Real-Time service disconnects.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to launch an application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to stop an application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to hide an application.

methods.name: onXcastApplicationResumeRequest

methods.name: onLocateCastTimer

methods.description: Checks if RFC service status allows Cast.
